title: Guiding Leaders Applications Open
html:
By News Staff

November 17, 2026

Share

Glidewell is accepting applications for its 2027 Guiding Leaders program, a six-month, in-person business and leadership development program for practicing dentists. For the first time, the program will be offered at two locations: Glidewell’s campus in Irvine, California, and a new East Coast site in Raleigh, North Carolina.

The company says the Raleigh location is intended to bring the program closer to East Coast dentists, who previously had to travel to Irvine for each session. Since the program launched in 2019, it has mentored 180 alumni from practices across the United States, Canada, and Puerto Rico.

“Dentistry is changing faster than ever, and our program changes with it,” said Bobbie Norton, director of Guiding Leaders. “The best leaders never stop growing. Bringing Guiding Leaders to Raleigh means more dentists can find the clarity, confidence, and community that so many of our graduates describe as career-altering.”

According to Glidewell, the curriculum is reviewed and refreshed annually. Core topics include relational leadership, practice management, human resources strategy, financial literacy, clinical photography, personal branding, and public speaking.

The company says graduates have gone on to expand their practices, become owners, and speak at industry events. It also says many remain involved through the alumni network, mentoring new participants and collaborating with peers.

"Dentistry can be isolating, and Guiding Leaders was built to change that," Norton added. "Whether a dentist joins us in Irvine or Raleigh, they become part of a community that is genuinely invested in their success."

Glidewell fully sponsors the program. Participants pay for airfare, while the company covers other costs, including two nights of hotel accommodations for each session.

Applications for both locations are open through March 5, 2027. Applicants select a preferred location and submit a brief written application along with an introductory video.

More information is available at guidingleaders.com.
